messages.author: 37aa5738e3b37a20
messages.subject: installation problem
parts:
I have a installation problem via skyline.

I installed MSstat and there was some problems. So I removed them to try reinstall.
then I got that massage when install MSstat from toolstore.
How can I fix it?

messages.author: 99540594784b9805
messages.subject: Re: installation problem
parts:
Can you press the "More Info" button and copy the text of the message?

When you press Ctrl+C in a Skyline message box, that is supposed to copy the entire text of the message, including whatever appears when you press "More Info".
If that does not work, you should be able to select all of the textbox that appears when you press "More Info" and copy it.

messages.author: 99540594784b9805
messages.subject: Re: installation problem
parts:
You should reinstall R version 3.5.0.

Skyline thinks that you already have that version of R, but there is something wrong with it, and it is not installed where it is supposed to be.

You can find more information about this error here:
https://skyline.ms/announcements/home/support/thread.view?rowId=37089
